body.resource_hint: For V3 proportional to lambda and V4 proportional to lambda^2, every connected graph obeys d_lambda=sum_v(n_v-2)=E+2L-2. At d_lambda=4 the pairs are (E,L)=(6,0),(4,1),(2,2),(0,3); the last is a vacuum graph. A three-particle input requires E>=4; E=4 would be 3-to-1, impossible because P^2=256/25 while the one massless output has p^2=0. Thus the source-connected column is tree 3-to-3. Complement symmetry makes its generic Choi matrix block diagonal on kappa parity, so the positive even source has only positive even species outputs. On a common compact regular acceptance with every oriented D_B>=d, the unpartitioned physical kernel sum has ||A||^2<=12960 lambda^8 T^2 mu(X)mu(Y)/d^2, ten times the square-partition detector bound.
